A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Curry Rices are made by [[Cooking]] [[Hylian Rice]] and [[Goron Spice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They can be eaten to restore two [[Heart]]s to [[Link]], and they also sell for 20 [[Rupee]]s. They are a favorite all over [[Hyrule]], noted to be a simple dish with a flavor people do not get tired of. Curry Rice is mentioned as part of the "[[Curry for What Ails You]]" [[Side Quest]]. [[Lester]], a [[Stable Worker]] at [[Rito Stable]], enjoys spice, specifically Curry Rice.{{Cite|The thing about me is...I just can't get enough spice in my life. Spicyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy... I need that burny tingle... I need {{Color BotW|Blue|curry rice}}!|Lester|BotW}} While he has [[Hylian Rice]], he does not have any [[Goron Spice]].{{Cite|Now, I have {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian rice}} on hand, which I need to make {{Color BotW|Blue|curry rice}}, but I'm fresh out of {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}}!|Lester|BotW}} He will request Link bring him Goron Spice,{{Cite|If you happen to get your hands on some {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}}, can you give it to me?|Lester|BotW}} which begins the "[[Curry for What Ails You]]" [[Side Quest]]. As a reward for completing the quest, Lester will give Link 50 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|Hey... Could I ask you to part with that {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} for, say, {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}?|Lester|BotW}} Only fruits (and [[Courser Bee Honey]]) can be added to Curry Rice. Otherwise, the resulting dishes will be different Meals. Using additional [[Ingredient]]s will create the following variations: * '''Hearty Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Curry Rice}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Durian]]s. They heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum number of Hearts when eaten. They are worth 50 Rupees when sold. * '''Energizing Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Curry Rice}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding Courser Bee Honey. When eaten, they restore a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Curry Rice}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]]. When eaten, Link's speed will be temporarily boosted. They heal three of Link's Hearts and sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Spicy Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Curry Rice}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Spicy Pepper]]. Eating one will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. They restore three Hearts and sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Electro Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Curry Rice}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfruit]]. If they are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. They heal six of Link's Hearts and can also be sold for 30 Rupees. * '''Mighty Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Curry Rice}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Bananas]]. Eating these will temporarily boost the power of Link's attacks. They will also restore three of Link's Hearts, and they sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Chilly Curry Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Curry Rice}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A favorite all over Hyrule, this simple dish has a flavor you just won't get tired of.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hydromelon]]s. When they are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]] for a short period of time. They heal three Hearts and sell for 30 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Curry Rice returns in {{TotK}} with an identical base recipe. It can be made in either a [[Cooking Pot]] or a [[Portable Pot]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Curry Rice appears in {{AoC}} as an unlockable [[Recipe]]. The Recipe is unlocked after completing the [[Scenario]] "[[All Hyrule, United]]". Like in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, it is made with [[Hylian Rice]] and [[Goron Spice]]. If made, [[Warrior]]s will start the battle with an extra two [[Heart]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Curry Rice Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Curry Rice ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
